Title: 502216-2026: France – Transport systems consultancy services – Construction of the Centre Opérationnel de la Mobilité (COM) in the municipality of Périgueux, project management consultation, tender phase
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Depot/operational mobility centre for bus lines – bus depots are of interest for sbp. Project in France (outside DACH) and presumably primarily an operations/logistics building without major structural engineering challenges, therefore medium priority.
titel: Construction of the Centre for Mobility Operations (COM) in the municipality of Périgueux – planning services
kurzbeschreibung: In Périgueux (France), a new Centre Opérationnel de la Mobilité (COM) for the operation and maintenance of local bus lines is being built. The tender now awarded concerns comprehensive planning services (maîtrise d'oeuvre), including technical consultancy for transport systems.
gewinner_rolle: Planning team/maîtrise d'oeuvre (architectural and engineering services)
projektbeteiligte:
Communauté d'Agglomération du Grand Périgueux – contracting authority (public local authority)
LABA – winner, planning team/maîtrise d'oeuvre
Tribunal administratif de Bordeaux – review body
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Bus depot/mobility centre, generally thematically in line with sbp references
- Presumably a medium-sized, functional building without explicitly highlighted complex structure
- Structural design very likely an integral part of the awarded maîtrise d'oeuvre services
- Location outside DACH, not a key market, no special structures with large spans identifiable
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- France, checking engineer services are not institutionalised as in Germany
- No indications of exceptionally large or complex structures
- No explicit requirement for independent structural checking services tendered
- Project size presumably limited, therefore only low potential
baukosten_erklaerung: No information in the TED text; a sound estimate is not possible.
naechste_schritte: No active steps required. Record the project for monitoring of references for bus depots/mobility centres, but do not make direct contact with the winner LABA or the contracting authority, as the maîtrise-d'oeuvre services have already been fully awarded.
notes: CPV 71311200 (Transport systems consultancy services) as well as 71200000/71300000/71310000 indicate a comprehensive planning mandate in which structural design is typically included. Winner LABA is identified as a large company based in Paris 10. No information on fee or construction volume in the TED document.
